# Salam Aksimi (سلام اقسيمي)

> Personal Branding Supervisor on LinkedIn | Turning curiosity into skills | Interactive storytelling that empowers growth. Based in Damascus, Syria. Personal-branding and LinkedIn content specialist, trainer and presenter. Website in Arabic (default) and English.

## Key facts
- 50+ LinkedIn profiles given personal-branding consultations; 80+ profiles developed and guided; 5 people landed their ideal job; about 10 started creating content; LinkedIn accounts and content managed for about 5 clients.
- Pro Team (Dec 2025 – Sep 2026): Copywriter, LinkedIn Specialist, Social Media Content Creator; volunteer Presenter and Public Relations Officer; 5+ training workshops; 200+ volunteer hours.
- Moderated a panel at Sharaf AI 2026; trained 20 participants over 8 hours at Jisr Media, Damascus (18–19 Sep 2026); hosted International Youth Day 2026 (JobLink Syria); ran a LinkedIn meetup in Aleppo (23 Jul 2026).
- Student of IT engineering (AI track) at the Arab International University (2023 – 2028).
- 14 certificates: LinkedIn Learning, Coursera, Meta, IBM, DeepLearning.AI, Security Blue Team, NASBA, LexiTech.
